Intermediate Cert Resource Finalize Cert
POST
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/intermediateCaCertificate/finalizeCert/:certId

Finalizes the intermediate CA certificate with the specified ID.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
certId
int32
REQUIRED

The unique identifier for the intermediate CA certificate.

Responses
​
200

Successful Operation
